name: CyberNet [BETA]
desc:
CyberNet is a unique UI based hacking simulator game, where you hack into networks and devices to earn money while avoiding the authorities and other players.

• Upgrade your Computer and Home Security
• Scan and Hack into networks and devices
• Steal Ro-Coin
• Join or Create a Guild
• Rob Banks over the Net
• Purchase Rare Exploits and Useful Tools
• Don't get Caught 

⚠️ CyberNet IS IN BETA. Expect frequent updates. Report bugs in our community server.
